rows.note: For the large-meal sense, this is the all-purpose casual choice for an unusually big meal.

example.traditional: 今晚我哋食咗一餐大餐。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 sik6 zo2 jat1 caan1 daai6 caan1

rows.note: Use this for the ceremonial or banquet-style slice of the large-meal sense, focusing on the hosted event.

example.english: They held a big feast at the hotel.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺酒店搞咗場大型宴會。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 zau2 dim3 gaau2 zo2 coeng4 daai6 jing4 jin3 wui6

rows.note: Use this when “feast” means a holiday or festival, especially a religious one, rather than a meal.

example.english: Christmas is my favourite feast day.
example.traditional: 聖誕節係我最鍾意嘅節日。
example.jyutping: sing3 daan3 zit3 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 zit3 jat6
